title: ask prompt pump: watchdog dismiss+resend recovery before BUG-AUTO
desc: AskCommands.CdpPromptPump watchdog fires when editor retains text 10s after submit -- cause is usually a promo popover (Claude CoWork, Gemini copyright) eating the click. Watchdog now runs DismissDialogAsync + SendPromptAsync re-fire before declaring stuck; only actual unrecoverable cases hit AutoRegisterBug.
steps: Pump arms watchdog after last append
T+7s: check editor text length; if >0 editor still has content
Recovery call DismissDialogAsync -- closes CoWork promo banners, Gemini copyright dialogs, X-icon popovers
T+10s: recheck; if still stuck BUG-AUTO with 'recovery failed' hint
Quiet when no popover (NONE return); self-heals when popover was the blocker

LIVE CASE 2026-07-02: ts=2026-06-16T07:36:36 -- watchdog correctly detected 4308 chars stuck in editor after 30s, ran BOTH dismiss+resend recovery attempts (AskCommands.CdpPromptPump.cs ~line 114-163), both failed to clear the editor, then logged BUG-AUTO as designed. This is the watchdog WORKING AS INTENDED (a symptom detector), not itself broken -- the real question is WHY submit never cleared the editor that day (candidates: a UI overlay/banner blocking the submit click that dismiss missed, the isSending flag never resetting, focusless Enter not reaching a ProseMirror-style editor, or Chrome throttling delaying the CDP submit signal past the 30s window). NOT YET DIAGNOSED -- needs a repro with [ASK:PUMP] console.error log capture to identify which failure mode actually fired.
